questions.questionTextEn: According to Keynesian approach, the effect of devaluation is explained by which of the following analytical approach?
questions.explanation: Sydney Alexander has analyzed the effect of devaluation on income on the basis of Keynesian approach. According to the absorption theory of devaluation, if a country has a deficit in its balance of payments, so people are absorbing more than they are producing. Y = C+Id+X-M Where, Y = National income, X = Export C = Consumption expenditure M= Import Id = Investment • If C+Id is called total absorption(A) and (X-M) is called balance of payments (B) then - Y = A+B B Y A = − • Hence, the balance of payment is the difference between Y and A. The balance of payment can be improved by increasing domestic income or by reducing absorption. Therefore Alexander suggests devaluation for this approach.
